subject: planner: right deal with predicate in the join reorder (#62561)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on planner join reorder changes. The commit exports `logicalop.AddSelection` and uses it in join reorder to materialize side-only predicates as `LogicalSelection` nodes for inner joins (clearing `LogicalJoin.LeftConditions/RightConditions`), preventing predicates from being stranded on inner-join side conditions and improving compatibility (e.g. MPP join planning restrictions on left/right conditions). No remaining Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics issues found in the touched planner code; later upstream history keeps the same core approach.
